newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rabo sees slower net profit growth in H2.
newsitem.headline: Rabo sees slower net profit growth in H2.

text.p: Dutch cooperative bank Rabobank Nederland said on Monday it expected a rise in net profits in the second 1996 half, although earnings growth would be slower than in the first half.

"Barring unforeseen circumstances, a higher pre-tax operating profit and a higher net profit is also expected in the second half compared to the same period of the previous year," the bank said in a statement.
But it added that the 21.5 percent year-on-year jump in profits achieved in the first half would not be matched in the second half.
"The expected slowdown may be explained particularly by the gradual acceleration of profit growth over 1995," Rabobank said.
It said it expected to book increased growth in lending, deposits and off-balance activities.
